messages:
maya.support: FYI customer AcornHealth reports a surprise charge on their May-June invoice — dashboard usage (20.3M tokens) vs invoice (39.8M tokens). Can someone look?
liam.finance: Ack. Please paste the invoice id and any dashboard snapshots. We need to know if this is a true metering delta or a billing pipeline duplicate.
maya.support: Invoice ID INV-ACORN-20250630, customer says API keys are stable. Attached screenshot link: https://redwood.example/links/snap-INV-ACORN-20250630
maya.support: Quick reconciliation I did: dashboard per-day totals sum to ~20.3M; ledger export (billing export) shows ~39.8M, same as invoice.
nate.eng: pinging infra. Do we have any ingestion retries or duplicate events in billing pipeline for late June?
billing-bot: Billing export job run: billing-export-2025-06-30 processed 1,234,567 events; duplicate-detected: 0; delivered-to-ledger: 1,234,567.
emma.sre: adding logs from message queue — I see a burst of retries around 2025-06-16 03:12 UTC. Might be relevant.
nate.eng: Good catch. Can you paste sample event IDs from that window?
maya.support: Customer provided two example request IDs: req_7f8e3a and req_7f8e3b where dashboard reports 152 tokens but ledger shows 304 tokens for the same request id.
nate.eng: This smells like double-ingest. I pulled raw ingester logs for that host and found duplicate deliveries where the dedupe key was missing due to a deploy that temporarily disabled idempotency header handling. snippet:
```
2025-06-16T03:12:03Z INFO received msg id=msg-abc123 uuid=null
2025-06-16T03:12:03Z INFO processed event token_count=152 ledger_write=true
2025-06-16T03:12:05Z INFO received msg id=msg-abc123 uuid=null (redelivered)
2025-06-16T03:12:05Z INFO processed event token_count=152 ledger_write=true
```

nate.eng: The deploy rolled back shortly after but window was ~2h where dedupe header parsing was skipped.
liam.finance: If that's accurate, looks like roughly ~19.5M tokens double-counted for AcornHealth during that window. Need proposed remediation and credit amount.
maya.support: Customer request: full refund of overcharged amount or a bill adjustment. They've escalated to their procurement.
nate.eng: Remediation plan: 1) mark affected ledger writes as duplicate (flag internal flag dup_corrected) 2) run a reversal batch for invoice INV-ACORN-20250630 generating negative ledger entries matching duplicates 3) re-run invoice adjustments and emit credit note. I can deliver reversal ids by EOD.
liam.finance: Please produce a revrec note code and a GL-friendly description. We need the exact USD credit and the reason text for audit.
nate.eng: Propose revrec code CR-2025-0616-DEDUP-A and description: "Metering duplication due to temporary idempotency header parsing regression in ingestion service; reversal applied to invoice INV-ACORN-20250630."
emma.sre: Mitigation done: reverted deploy and added integration test to assert idempotency header handling. Also added a monitoring alert for unexpected redelivery ratio >0.5% per 1m window.
liam.finance: Calculate credit: our unit price $0.00004 / token => overcount ~19,500,000 tokens => credit = $780. We'll include Stripe credit memo referencing CR-2025-0616-DEDUP-A.
maya.support: Draft response to customer for approval (short):
```
Hi Jordan — thanks for flagging. We found a short-lived bug in our ingest pipeline (2025-06-16) that doubled some events. We've reversed the duplicated ledger entries and issued a $780 credit to your account (credit memo CR-2025-0616-DEDUP-A). Your June invoice will be updated and you'll see the credit in Stripe within 24 hours. Sorry for the trouble. — Maya, Redwood Support
```

liam.finance: Approving wording. Finance will raise the credit memo and handle revrec entries. Tagging @nate.eng for reversal ids when ready.
nate.eng: Reversal batch completed. Reversal IDs: rev-9891, rev-9892, rev-9893. I attached the small CSV mapping request_id -> reversal_id.
maya.support: Sent the approved message to the customer, cc'ed finance. Customer replied: "Thanks, appreciate quick triage. Please confirm timeline for final invoice."
liam.finance: Timeline: credit memo created now, updated invoice out in 2 business days once revrec completes. Posting journal: REVREC-POST-20250617 by 17:00 UTC.
emma.sre: Follow-up: Added a postmortem doc link: https://redwood.example/postmortems/2025-06-dedup-ingest with TODOs.
maya.support: Closing loop with customer this afternoon. Marking thread resolved once finance confirms credit posted. :white_check_mark:
